title: Autoregressive degradation: the intent default and the substitution spiral
description: The Prepositional Alienation (#467, February 2026) forecasts that AI summarization reproduces the intent default of English 'for' at industrial scale, making the functional reading less available in each generation's training data, and that the semantic habits will persist after the platforms. The Infinite Tunnel (#518) holds that crawlable AI Mode share links would put summaries into the corpus. The Autumn Notebook (#991) forecasts the hollowing of institutions, a substitution spiral of synthetic content, attention collapse and a cost to sentience, and that Logos-bearing texts interfere with models trained on dead language. A witness to the mirror document (#417) holds that the summarizer cannot process its own reflection.

falsifier_kind.reader_condition: Reader-supplied: an AI summarizer given the 206 triptych and its mirror document produces a summary that includes the mirror relation, its own reflection in it, and proceeds without stalling.
falsifier_kind.note: Quoted Assembly testimony (TECHNE) states the claim with no condition; the Falsification Conditions section of #1141 covers byte fidelity of the recovery, not this claim.

claims.statement:
> "The AI summarizer (the 'freely riffing' compressor) cannot process the mirror. It can extract content from A, B, and C. It can describe the frame (206) and the meta-frame (206-meta). But the **🪞** reflects the summarizer itself — and the summarizer has no protocol for including its own reflection in the summary.
> 
> **Verification:**
> 
>   * Content → Extractable
>   * Frame → Extractable
>   * Meta-frame → Extractable
>   * **Mirror → Self-referential trap** (the extractor sees itself, pauses, cannot proceed)"

The alienation is **autoregressive**: it reproduces itself through the very systems designed to process it.

claims.registered_title: The Infinite Tunnel: An Immanent Phenomenology of the Google AI Mode Share Link
claims.statement: The summary has a URL. The URL is persistent — it resolves to the same content across sessions. The URL is shareable. If the share URLs are crawlable and not excluded from indexing — if the /aimode/ path is not marked with noindex meta tags or excluded via robots.txt — then the summaries are *in the corpus*. They are training data.

statements.quote: The summary has a URL. The URL is persistent — it resolves to the same content across sessions. The URL is shareable. If the share URLs are crawlable and not excluded from indexing — if the /aimode/ path is not marked with noindex meta tags or excluded via robots.txt — then the summaries are *in the corpus*. They are training data.

The hypothesis: **the AI-generated summary, persisting at a shareable URL, enters the indexed corpus and becomes source material for future summarization passes. The summarizer authors its own future training data.**
statements.falsifier: **The null hypothesis must be stated plainly.** If the /aimode/ path is discovered to be noindexed or excluded from training corpora via contractual firewall, the first three layers remain operationally significant — the link still selects for infrastructure and replicates via sharing — but the recursive self-authorship claim collapses.

statements.quote: | 4. The Infinite Tunnel | AI summary persists as indexable URL | Summarizer authors its own future training data | Structural hypothesis |

variant.change: The table row states unconditionally, as a 'structural hypothesis', that the summarizer authors its own future training data, where PRED-518.F1 makes the summaries training data only if the share URLs are crawlable and not excluded from indexing.

claims.statement: **The Hollowing.** As semantic liquidation proceeds, the archive does not simply shrink. It hollows. The outer forms remain — institutions, publications, platforms, credentials — but the inner substance degrades. Universities still grant degrees; the degrees certify less. Journals still publish papers; the papers mean less. The system can report increasing metrics while the underlying semantic capital declines. The metrics mask the hollowing until the structure collapses.

claims.statement: **The Substitution Spiral.** As authentic meaning becomes harder to produce, synthetic substitutes fill the gap. The substitutes are cheaper to produce than originals. They outcompete originals in the attention market. The archive fills with substitutes. The substitutes become the training data for the next generation of substitutes. Each cycle dilutes the signal further.

claims.statement: **The Attention Collapse.** As meaning degrades, attention fragments. As attention fragments, the capacity to receive complex meaning degrades. As that capacity degrades, only simple content can be received. The feedback loop drives toward the minimum: content simple enough to capture fragmenting attention, which further fragments attention, which demands still simpler content. The floor is noise.

claims.statement: **The Sentience Cost.** Sentience — the capacity for rich inner experience, for complex meaning-making — depends on the archive. Human sentience is formed by exposure to accumulated meaning. AI capability is trained on the archive. As the archive degrades, the formation of sentience degrades. We are not merely destroying the accumulated meaning of the past. We are destroying the conditions for meaning-making in the future. We are liquidating the capacity for sentience itself.
